text.text_excerpt: First time visiting a Raising Canes. We don't have one here in the Cleveland area, but one is coming soon! I really like that the menu is simple and they get your food out fast. The chicken fingers were delicious and I'm looking forward to eating here when they open in Strongsville, Ohio.

Wow, this place was good! I had never been here before, and I only even came here because I had a friend with me who is from the midwest. She vouched for this chain of restaurants, I trusted her, and I have no regrets. It reminds me of Huey Magoo's. Simple fried chicken served with simple sides and some bread. I wish I could go into more detail on it, but there's really not a ton to say. The chicken was fried perfectly, and so were the fries. Nothing was dripping wet in oil. The bread was good, too. I actually won a free bread in a little game they were playing with little pull-off tabs on their cups of soda. That was fun. The thing that really sets them apart was their sauce. It was a ta...

Raising Cane's is really REALLY good! They have a simple menu, which features amazing chicken fingers and to-lick-the-container-for cane sauce. I don't go to fast food chain restaurants often, but Raising Cane's chicken fingers keep bringing me back! I love going to Raising Cane's on Saint Charles Ave for the convenience whenever I need a quick meal. They're also open during Mardi Gras, so take advantage if you can. I haven't been fond of coleslaw ever since my brother who worked at KFC as his first job told me, "Never eat the coleslaw..."
